summary: CRH America Finance, Inc., a Delaware subsidiary of CRH plc, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $4.2 billion four-tranche senior unsecured note offering: $1.35B 5.375% notes due 2032, $1.0B 5.625% notes due 2034, $1.35B 5.750% notes due 2037 and $500M 6.250% notes due 2057, all fully and unconditionally guaranteed by CRH plc, with interest semiannual from February 2027. Proceeds partly fund concurrent cash tender and exchange offers for Arcosa's 4.375% 2029 and 6.875% 2032 notes; the offering is not conditioned on those concurrent offers, which carry their own conditions.
